datePolicy: All URL entries retain the register's explicit 2026-11-06 UTC+8 access date; some underlying receipts are 2026-11-05 UTC. Localization on 2026-11-06 is not an external research, legal, price or availability refresh. Document effective dates, schedule years and advertisement labels are distinct from access dates.
uncertainties: Hong Kong family: Traditional Chinese would serve this audience better, but Simplified Chinese is the only Chinese locale in the package; zh is therefore Simplified Chinese, not a Traditional Chinese adaptation.

Not immigration, tax or legal advice. Actual passports, roles, individual incomes, employer registration, tax/payroll obligations, health cover and approvals remain unverified; two working adults need separate work-authorisation assessment.

MDEC v11 Student Pass wording conflicts with Taylor's annual Permission to Study stamp wording. Applicable child study route, charges, endorsement/bond treatment and timing require reconciliation before commitment.

School places, DOB-dependent placement, English/learning support and future invoices unconfirmed. Taylor 2027 is calendar-year pricing; other schools latest located 2026/27, not 2027/28. HELP technology and deposit amounts unknown; school-specific SST treatment and discounts need actual invoices.

Lean rent 3000 and short school rides at 15 per leg are targets not verified as a combined available package. Progression model 18385 uses frozen 2027 Y4/Y7 rates conditionally, not published 2028 fees; deposit top-up 2780.

Twelve advertisements are selective asking-rent samples seen 2026-11-06, not authenticated current or August 2027 vacancies, market medians or tenancy-eligibility confirmations. Relative posting labels and omitted years preserved. Source register additionally records South Brooks index confirmation as 2026-09-18; reader table preserves direct-ad year omission.

All non-tuition household budgets, insurance, transport fares and car capital are estimates. No live route fare, underwriting, exact-unit utility bill, network backup or continuous car-rental all-in terms confirmed. Insurance is local hospital cover with waiting periods, not global protection or pass-compliance assurance.

82260 is an upfront-commitment subtotal, not sufficient arrival cash. The conditional 97355–98555 illustration still excludes unresolved child charges, temporary stay, flights/shipping, emergency liquidity and car capital. Prepayments of tuition/insurance must not be counted twice.
No contacts, applications, bookings, payments or external refresh were performed for localization; original source register documents public-page evidence, not individual approvals.
editingContract: Complete reader-first English and Simplified Chinese with numeric/date/currency/external URL multiplicities and corresponding table-cell parity. Local draft only; no ratings or Review markup; no unhosted attachment promises or reader-body local pointers.
